name: conch
description: Skills for agents running agents in conch: start a helper and read its answer (conch), several at once (conch-team), review until clean (conch-review), tests to a merged PR (conch-ship), a ticket all the way (conch-factory), the automated workflow for a project (conch-autopilot), testing a branch as a user would (conch-qa), red CI and deploys (conch-cicd), a project set up for agents (conch-setup) and what every agent is doing (conch-status). They act only inside a conch pane; install conch from https://amitgb14.github.io/conch/.
